description.narrative: Core support to Center For Rights Education and Awareness (CREAW) proposed strategic plan 2024-2028. The proposed Strategic Plan 2024­-2028 has identify six strategic priority areas: -­ Investing in Women and Girl’S Economic Empowerment -­ Addressing Violence Against Women and Girls -­ Advancing Comprehensive Sexual Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR) ­- Strengthening Localisation of Resources for Women Rights Organisation, Movements And Collectives -­ Women And Girls Participation in Leadership and Decision Making -­ Institutional Strengthening and Growth

Kärnstöd till Center for Rights Education and Awareness (CREAW) föreslagna strategisk plan 2024-­2028. Plan identifierar sex prioriterade områden för perioden;
- Stärka arbetet för att eliminera våld mot kvinnor och flickor ­- Stärka kvinnor och flickors ledarskap och deltagande i beslutsfattande - Stärka sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR) -­ Öka resurser till lokala kvinnorättsorganisationer och rörelser (’lokalisering’) - ­ Stärka kvinnors ekonomiska egenmakt ­ - Institutionell utveckling

The overall impact that CREAW wants to achieve is Women and girls live dignified, productive and fulfilled lives. CREAW's Theory of Change (TOC) is: By fostering an environment of equity, inclusivity, and safety for women and girls, coupled with increased agency, voice, and action in leadership and decisionmaking roles, and bolstered by improved socioeconomic wellbeing and autonomy in the workforce, we aim to facilitate the transformation towards women and girls living productive, dignified, and fulfilled lives. This will be achieved through the collective efforts of responsive policy frameworks, survivorcentred services for GenderBased Violence (GBV) survivors, enhanced prevention and response mechanisms to end Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG), increased opportunities for women's leadership and decisionmaking, improved access to dignified work and economic opportunities, and a shift in societal norms towards embracing Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR). 6 Strategic Priorities have been identified in the transitional strategic plan: STRATEGIC PRIORITY 1: ADDRESSING VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND GIRLS STRATEGIC PRIORITY 2: WOMEN AND GIRLS PARTICIPATION IN LEADERSHIP AND DECISION MAKING STRATEGIC PRIORITY 3: ADVANCING COMPREHENSIVE SEXUAL REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH RIGHTS STRATEGIC PRIORITY 4: STRENGTHENING LOCALISATION OF RESOURCES FOR WOMEN RIGHTS ORGANISATION, MOVEMENTS AND COLLECTIVES STRATEGIC PRIORITY 5: INVESTING IN WOMEN AND GIRLS ECONOMIC EMPOWERMENT STRATEGIC PRIORITY 6: INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND GROWTH

tag.narrative: 5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.2 - Avskaffa alla former av våld mot alla kvinnor och flickor i det offentliga och privata rummet, inklusive människohandel, sexuellt utnyttjande och andra typer av exploatering.
5.2 - Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

5.6 - Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights as agreed in accordance with the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development and the Beijing Platform for Action and the outcome documents of their review conferences.

5.6 - Säkerställa allmän tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och reproduktiva rättigheter i enlighet med överenskommelserna i handlingsprogrammet från den internationella konferensen om befolkning och utveckling, Pekingplattformen samt slutdokumenten från respektive översynskonferenser.

5.a - Genomföra reformer för att ge kvinnor lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till finansiella tjänster, arv och naturresurser, i enlighet med nationell lagstiftning

5.a - Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to ownership and control over land and other forms of property, financial services, inheritance and natural resources, in accordance with national laws.
